title: Group Fitness Class Passes: private group booking terms and corporate wellness discount rate by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states whether a private group class may be booked with the pack, the maximum participants in such a booking and its surcharge, and the discount rate available to a holder who is also enrolled in an active corporate wellness partnership.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes whether a private group class booking is permitted and, where permitted, the maximum number of participants and the surcharge charged for the booking. Each tier separately fixes a corporate wellness discount rate: the percentage this tier itself is willing to reduce a charge or add to a refund by, for a holder who at the relevant moment also holds an active corporate wellness enrollment. How that rate is compared against the employer's own discount rate, and where it is applied, is stated in the documents governing each specific charge or refund it affects.

| Tier | Private group booking allowed | Max participants | Private group surcharge (USD) | Corporate wellness discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | No | 1 | 0 | 5% |
| 10-Class Pack | No | 1 | 0 | 5% |
| 20-Class Pack | No | 1 | 0 | 8% |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | No | 1 | 0 | 5% |
| Specialty Studio Pack | Yes | 4 | 60.00 | 10% |
| Founding Class Pass | No | 1 | 0 | 0% |

## Points of judgement
- Only the Specialty Studio Pack permits a private group booking; every other tier's maximum participants remains 1, meaning no private group booking applies to them.
- The Specialty Studio Pack carries both the private group option and the highest corporate wellness discount rate (10%) of any tier; the Founding Class Pass is the only tier with no corporate wellness discount at all (0%).
